title: Product Manager (Software Products)
description:
**Job description:**

Key Responsibilities

* Gather business requirements and translate them into functional specifications, user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Define product roadmaps, manage backlogs and prioritize features based on business requirements and technical feasibility.
* Work closely with engineering and QA teams to drive end-to-end product development and delivery.
* Understand and contribute to technical discussions around Microservices Architecture, REST APIs, databases, Kafka and distributed systems.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies, sprint planning, backlog refinement, UAT and product releases.
* Identify opportunities to integrate Generative AI, LLMs and AI-powered automation into software products.
* Monitor product performance, user feedback and continuously improve product capabilities.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Minimum 5 years of overall experience, preferably including 2–3 years in software development followed by experience in Product Management / Product Ownership.
* Prior hands-on development experience in Node.js, Express.js, NestJS or similar backend technologies.
* Strong understanding of SDLC, Agile/Scrum and software architecture.
* Knowledge of Microservices Architecture, distributed systems and Event-Driven Architecture.
* Working knowledge of Apache Kafka, REST APIs, SQL, databases and system integrations.
* Experience in product backlog management, requirement gathering, user stories and feature prioritization.
* Hands on experience on CI/CD pipeline.
* Familiarity with JIRA, Confluence, Postman, Swagger or similar tools.
* Strong analytical, communication, problem-solving and stakeholder management skills.

AI & Emerging Technology Exposure (Good to Have)

* Understanding of Generative AI, LLMs and Prompt Engineering.
* Familiarity with AI Agents, Agentic AI and multi-agent systems.
* Exposure to OpenAI APIs, Azure OpenAI, MCP and AI-powered workflow automation.

Good to Have

* Exposure to fintech, banking or investment management.
* Knowledge of fund accounting, NAV computation, accounting and reconciliations.
* Familiarity with AWS/Azure, Docker, Kubernetes and cloud-based application architecture.

Experience:

* Full-stack development: 4 years (Required)
* Product management: 2 years (Required)

Benefits:

* Health & Life insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund + Gratuity

Work Schedule:

* 11 AM to 8 PM IST
* 5 Days work

Budget : ₹400,000.00 - ₹500,000.00 per year (Negotiable)
